_comment: Snapshot of the protocol constants the economics model reads. Regenerate with `python3 sim/economics/extract_constants.py --write` and review the diff -- a change here is a change to the economics.

BPS_DENOMINATOR.note: Basis-point denominator used by every fee computation.

CHALLENGER_BOND_BPS.note: Challenger bond as bps of the coverage a filing freezes (1.5%).

DEFAULT_AGENT_FEE_BPS.note: The performance fee a vault charges out of the box (the '20' in 2-and-20).

DEFAULT_MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE_BPS.note: Per-vault performance ceiling a new vault starts at; equals the default rate, so the vault fails closed rather than open.

EPOCH_LENGTH_DAYS.note: Exposure epoch length; immutable in the ledger once constructed.

FORFEIT_BURN_BPS.note: Slice of a LOSING challenger's forfeited bond that is burned.

FULL_NOTIONAL_BPS.note: Coverage bound for an uncertified (tier-2) call: the full notional.

GAME_CHALLENGE_WINDOW_DAYS.note: The game's own copy of the challenge window; must track the ledger's.

GUARDIAN_EPOCH_DURATION_DAYS.note: Registry epoch, also the refundSlash cap window.

K_NUMERATOR.note: USD of coverage bookable per USD of haircut-priced stake.

LEDGER_CHALLENGE_WINDOW_DAYS.note: Post-epoch challenge window held by the ledger.

LEDGER_DEFAULT_WOOD_HAIRCUT_BPS.note: The ledger's OWN default haircut. Written symbolically as BPS_DENOMINATOR, i.e. NO haircut. Only DeployPlanB overwrites it.

MANAGEMENT_FEE_BPS_DEPLOYED.note: The management rate a mainnet deploy actually ships with (env-overridable).

MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE_BPS.note: Hard ceiling on the management fee (5%/yr).

MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE_BPS.note: Hard protocol ceiling on the performance fee. The `worst_stack` fee set runs here.

MAX_SLASH_BPS.note: Upper clamp on any slash. 100% as deployed.

MAX_STRATEGY_DAYS_DEPLOYED.note: Deploy-time strategy-duration ceiling in DAYS. Lower than the factory's 30d.

MAX_STRATEGY_DURATION_DAYS.note: Governor-parameter ceiling on a single strategy. Note Deploy.s.sol ships MAX_STRATEGY_DAYS at 14, which binds first.

MGMT_SPLIT_AGENT_BPS.note: Agent share of the management fee.

MGMT_SPLIT_GUARDIAN_BPS.note: Guardian share of the management fee. docs/guardian-network.md still says 10% (SHE-229); the code says this.

MGMT_SPLIT_PROTOCOL_BPS.note: Protocol share of the management fee.

MIN_GUARDIAN_STAKE_WOOD.note: WOOD a guardian must stake to register at all.

MIN_OWNER_BOND_FLOOR_WOOD.note: Hard floor under the vault-owner bond; the effective bond is max(minOwnerStake, this).

MIN_OWNER_STAKE_WOOD.note: WOOD a vault owner must bond per fund.

MIN_SLASH_BPS.note: Lower clamp on any slash. An approver who underwrote a sliver still pays this share of their whole stake.

PARTICIPATION_FLOOR_BPS.note: Turnout floor below which a verdict is Inconclusive and the window re-arms. The model does not price re-arms (caveat A8).

PERF_SPLIT_AGENT_BPS.note: Agent share of the performance fee.

PERF_SPLIT_GUARDIAN_BPS.note: Guardian share of the performance fee. docs say 15% (SHE-229); the code says this.

PERF_SPLIT_OWNER_BPS.note: Vault-owner share of the performance fee. There is no owner leg on management.

PERF_SPLIT_PROTOCOL_BPS.note: Protocol share of the performance fee.

PLANB_REQUIRED_MAX_SLASH_BPS.note: Plan B pre-flight HARD-REQUIRES this maxSlashBps. It is why the slash is 100%.

PROPOSER_BOND_BPS.note: Proposer bond as bps of USD coverage (1%).

PROSECUTOR_FEE_BPS.note: Slice of the forfeited proposer bond paid to a winning challenger. The papers say 5%; the code says this.

SETTLE_BURN_BPS.note: Slice of a WINNING challenger's own bond that is burned.

TIER_ARBITRARY.note: The uncertified tier id. Everything ships in it: no script certifies.

WOOD_HAIRCUT_BPS.note: The haircut a Plan B deploy applies to the WOOD price when pricing stake. The model uses this, NOT the ledger default.

WOOD_USD_PRICE_X8_FORK.note: Derived spot WOOD/USD from the Robinhood fork's pool reserves. Extracted from a doc-comment usage line -- fragile by nature, see README 'Fragile patterns'.
